A node announcing itself on Nostr can still be unable to pay.

Mostro v0.20.0 adds payment deferral for an unhealthy LND backend and kind 38389 health events. A missing report is not an ok report.

We compared the published release with its merged payment and monitoring changes. The key limit: a signed node report still reflects that node's own view, not an independent check of the chain.
